changes.title: Former labor secretary created ‘toxic’ atmosphere, drank at work and misused funds, report says
changes.summary: Former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated multiple department policies during her tenure, including creating a hostile work environment, using government funds for personal travel and having an inappropriate relationship with an employee, according to a department watchdog.

changes.title: Former Labor Secretary Stoked Dysfunction and Toxicity, Department Report Finds
changes.summary: Lori Chavez-DeRemer spent Labor Department funds on personal travel and tolerated harassment in the agency, its inspector general found.
